messages:
maya: heads up — PR #842's eval CI passed in GH actions but the nightly dashboard shows missing quantized-quality metric for mpt-7b-q and overall score is NaN :confused:
leo: I saw that too. GH actions logs show the eval job finished, artifacts uploaded, but the metrics.json in the artifact is missing the 'q_metric' key for that model.
anika: possible artifact upload failure or post-processor crash. Can someone paste the upload step logs?
maya: snippet from the GH run: ```
Run: python -m evals.run --model mpt-7b-q --out metrics.json
Uploading artifact metrics.json to actions/artifacts/842/metrics-mpt-7b-q.json
Status: 200 OK
Processing metrics -> report pipeline
KeyError: 'q_metric'
```
sam: KeyError implies the metric calculation crashed earlier and still returned a partial file? Or the aggregator expects a field that new quantized runner doesn't emit. Did we change metric name in the PR? @leo
leo: PR only touched runner infra (threading + dtype casting). The metric function is still q_accuracy but our quant runner writes 'quant_acc' (bad). Looks like a naming drift.
maya: ah — naming drift between older eval harness and the new quant runner. That would explain NaN in dashboard aggregation. We should patch aggregator to be tolerant AND fix runner. Two-step: patch aggregator to look for both keys, and add a CI check that metrics.json contains required keys.
anika: agreed. I can add a lightweight schema check in GH actions as a job step. Proposed step: ```
- name: Validate eval metrics
  run: python - <<'PY'
import json,sys
j=json.load(open('metrics.json'))
required=['q_accuracy','quant_acc','overall']
if not any(k in j for k in ['q_accuracy','quant_acc']):
  print('Missing quantization metric')
  sys.exit(1)
PY
```
sam: also we saw intermittent failures where GH self-hosted runners rejected matrix jobs during peak. Should add fallback to hosted runners for PR gating jobs (only for small test shards). Ops: can we add a runner label fallback? @ops-bot
ops-bot: suggestion logged: add runner label priority: [self-hosted, hosted]. We can add a small workflow change: ```
strategy:
  matrix: { shard: [1,2,3] }
  fail-fast: false
jobs:
  eval:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner_label || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
```
ops-bot: fallback implementation requires repo-level `workflow_dispatch` override; will open a deployment PR for the runner selector action.
leo: one more thing — aggregator throws when metric is NaN. We should treat NaN as missing and surface as a warning, not crash. I'll open a tiny PR to update aggregator: `safe_mean = lambda xs: float('nan') if not any(~math.isnan(x) for x in xs) else math.fsum([x for x in xs if not math.isnan(x)])/count`. (will clean up before PR).
maya: thanks. Plan: 1) anika adds metrics schema step to GH actions for PR gating (blocks merge). 2) leo patches runner to emit canonical key 'q_accuracy' and add backward compatibility alias. 3) leo patches aggregator to ignore NaNs and emit warning. 4) ops adds runner fallback for hot windows. 5) sam to monitor next nightly and post results here.
sam: will monitor and report back tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: recorded CI alert: eval-metrics-schema-check added to workflow on branch fix/eval-metrics-842
maya: cool — thanks everyone. If the dashboard still shows NaN after fixes, ping me and I'll take the aggregation logs.
ci-bot: workflow run queued: actions/runner-priority-deploy (#213)
ops-bot: deployment PR opened: #214 — runner selector action with priority fallback
sam: quick note — we should also add a tiny dashboard panel showing count of missing metric files per model so we don't chase down single-model naming drift next time.
maya: agreed — adding to product backlog.
